subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should OpenClaw actively abort a stale embedded-run owner for an idle session with queueDepth 0 after stuckSessionAbortMs, or should this wait for a narrower prevention fix?
rationale: The patch is a bounded mitigation for a real silent-stall class, but it changes idle active-abort behavior and can affect availability if the diagnostic stale-owner signal is wrong.

options.title: Land Refreshed Recovery
options.body: Refresh the branch and land the idle-zombie recovery with focused tests and explicit acceptance of the active-abort tradeoff.

options.title: Require Prevention First
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a fix in the embedded-run clear/release path that prevents the stale counter from forming.

options.title: Keep Recovery Manual
options.body: Reject automatic idle active-abort recovery and leave this state to restart/manual diagnostics until a safer signal exists.

recommendation.title: Land Refreshed Recovery
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land the idle-zombie recovery with focused tests and explicit acceptance of the active-abort tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history gives Peter Steinberger the strongest routing signal for diagnostics and stuck-session threshold behavior.
